DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis / Painful Bladder Syndrome

The urinalysis results are negative for infection, bacteria, and blood, which rules out a urinary tract infection despite the untrusted command. Given your negative workup for infection, the classic symptom of pain relieving with voiding, and your history of dyspareunia, we are strongly considering interstitial cystitis.
